name: Newspaper Editorial
tagline: Broadsheet-style editorial deck with mastheads, ruled columns, grayscale imagery, pull quotes, and dense report layouts.

palette.description: Warm newspaper paper, black ink rules, grayscale image blocks, and occasional muted red and blue editorial accents.

typography.style: Classic newspaper serif mastheads paired with narrow sans captions and body columns.

best_for: Editorial reports, research digests, policy/news briefs, historical storytelling, and internal newsletters that need real column density.
avoid_for: High-energy pitch decks, app demos, or sparse visual keynotes where broadsheet density would feel too heavy.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesMania Newspaper Template
source_inspiration.notes: Low-fidelity page-by-page HTML/CSS reconstruction based on the public SlidesMania preview page and available PPTX/Google Slides source entry: newspaper masthead, ruled columns, grayscale image blocks, pull quotes, tables, and broadsheet spacing. The local soffice render path could not export the PPTX because of a missing native dylib, so this is not claimed as pixel-identical source rendering. No source assets are embedded.
